mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_idempotency_record ( user_id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_hash, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{operationType}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, appointment_id, CAST(result_json AS CHAR) AS result_json FROM sys_idempotency_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND operation_type = #{operationType} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
